rules.title: Requirements Upon Termination of Tenancy for No-Fault Just Cause; Relocation Assistance
rules.requirement: If a landlord ends a tenancy for a no-fault reason (such as demolition or substantial remodel), the landlord must give 30 or 60 days' written notice, pay relocation assistance equal to two months' rent (three months if the tenant is a senior or disabled), and offer the tenant the right to re-rent the unit if it's offered again within five years.
rules.key_value: 2 months' rent relocation assistance (3 months for seniors/disabled)
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential rental properties subject to San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 7 when a landlord issues a no-fault just cause termination notice.
rules.quoted_span: Unless section 98.0706(c)(1)(A)(ii) applies, the direct payment to the tenant shall be in an amount equal to two months of actual rent under the tenant's lease in effect at the date of the notice.
rules.conflict_note: Section amended 2-27-2024 by O-21769 N.S., effective 3-28-2024; original effective date was 6-24-2023.

rules.title: Buyout Agreement Disclosure and Void Agreement Requirements
rules.requirement: Before offering a tenant money to leave voluntarily (a buyout), landlords must give specific written disclosures about the tenant's rights, and any buyout agreement paying less than the required relocation assistance is void.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential rental properties subject to San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 7 where a landlord offers a buyout agreement to a tenant.
rules.quoted_span: Buyout agreements must be for an amount that is greater than the amount of relocation assistance available to the tenant in section 98.0706(c). A buyout agreement for less than the amount of relocation assistance owed to the tenant violates this Division and is void.
